description: 90 m² apartment in Prague: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Apartment interior design in Prague, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 90 m²

blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Prague, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 90 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a comprehensive project for a 90 m² apartment in Prague, Czech Republic. The project brought together interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a full turnkey renovation.

The layout and interior solutions cover the living room, bedrooms, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathrooms, and functional storage systems. Particular attention was paid to ergonomics, efficient use of space, and creating a comfortable living environment.

Custom furniture was designed and manufactured for the apartment, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems. The furniture was designed alongside the interior, which made it possible to integrate it precisely into the architecture of the rooms and maintain a unified stylistic concept.

Before implementation began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and other items specified in the project. Once the design stage was complete, a full turnkey renovation of the apartment was carried out in Prague in accordance with the technical documentation.

Photorealistic 3D visualizations were prepared for the project, making it possible to evaluate the future interior — the combination of materials, furniture, color schemes, and lighting — before implementation began.

This 90 m² apartment project showcases DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s end-to-end approach — from developing the interior design and technical solutions to manufacturing custom furniture and fully implementing the living space.
